summary.one_liner: A collection of five educational Jupyter notebook courses from Anthropic that teach the Claude API, prompt engineering, prompt evaluations, and tool use.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds five courses meant to be completed in a suggested order. The first, Anthropic API fundamentals, covers the Claude SDK basics: getting an API key, model parameters, multimodal prompts, and streaming responses. Prompt engineering interactive tutorial walks through key prompting techniques step by step, and an AWS Workshop version is noted. Real world prompting shows how to apply prompting techniques to complex prompts, with a Google Vertex version noted. Prompt evaluations covers writing production evaluations to measure prompt quality. Tool use teaches implementing tool use in workflows with Claude. The README notes that the courses mostly use Claude 3 Haiku to keep API costs low, though other Claude models can be used.
use_cases: learn the Claude API from scratch
notable: Five sequenced courses with a suggested completion order
Prompt engineering tutorial has an AWS Workshop version
Real world prompting has a Google Vertex version
Courses default to the lowest-cost Claude model to limit API spend
caveats: Running the courses requires an Anthropic API key and incurs API usage costs
The README does not describe setup steps, so the notebooks may need separate instructions
